posts.text: Want to talk to Cenk LIVE on air? If you’re a TYT member, soon you can! Starting April 20th, we’re excited to bring you Member Mondays, a new weekly show where TYT Members can call in via TYT’s official Discord server to talk directly with Cenk about the issues you care about most! Head over to tyt.com/call to become a member, join the Discord, and follow the instructions to verify your membership. See you next Monday on the air! 🎙️🔴

TYT is excited to partner with @joinnoblemobile, the ONLY phone plan that pays YOU to use your phone LESS! Get unlimited talk, text, and data on the reliable T-Mobile 5G Network. Your first month? Only $10. Make the switch today: go.tyt.com/noble
